metadata.rationale: H4 barrier contract: 3-bar horizon = 12 hours. SL=2.0xATR wider than H1 (1.8x) to account for larger H4 bar noise. TP=3.0xATR gives 1.50:1 RR. ATR on H4 candles.
metadata.design_notes: H4 resolution layer in HMRE architecture. 12h window matches swing/macro positioning. Wider barriers account for higher per-bar volatility on H4 timeframe.
